summary: Aermotor steel lookout built by the CCC in 1934 in McCreary County, Kentucky; registers record it demolished as of 2024, with a home on the site.

facts.design: 110-foot steel Aermotor tower with a 7 x 7 ft metal cab
facts.status_note: Demolished as of 2024 per the NHLR and FFLOS registers; a home now stands on the site.

access.note: Privately owned, per the NHLR; the registers describe no public access.

visit.trail_note: No tower remains. The site is private land at the end of Stearns Tower Road.

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps on Sunset Rock on the Cumberland National Forest; a 110-foot Aermotor steel tower with a 7 x 7 ft metal cab

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR says the CCC built the tower on the Cumberland National Forest, while the 2016 newspaper says the Forest Service leased the property from Stearns Coal. The story gives both accounts.
The 2016 newspaper describes the tower with lights and letters raised to its top, and the registers record it demolished as of 2024. The sources agree in time order.
The NHLR lists KY 6 and the former-sites register lists KY 7 for the same site, while the newspaper gives HWY 1561. The story names no route number.

notes_for_editor: Demolition rests on the NHLR and FFLOS registers, which are the same organization's two sites, and is dated only 'as of 2024'. The 2016 newspaper is the only independent source. The 1934 build is supported by three sources. No lookout names, staffing dates or notable fires were found. The 'abandoned' step has no year, so it is left out of events. Brief status 'standing' is corrected to removed.
